notes: U1 flag -> plain white flag was a recolour; now a long pennant banner. U2 dangling 'perched on its head' moved to placement.site='head'; v2 mask = statue head (SAM3 'head' in host, verified).

units.instruction_ref_zh: 将博物馆上方的红旗替换为一条红金相间的长三角旗。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一条红金相间的长三角旗。

units.instruction_ref_zh: 在最右侧的石质坐像的头顶上加上一只停歇的小鸽子。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一只停歇的小鸽子。
units.reason: Payload referred back to the host ('its head'); site is now 'head' and the mask is the statue's head (source box 2177,826-2221,867).
